1..4 max-jump values remain 0\\n- Admin capability bits 3/5/7 OFF\\n- native SetPosition execution not activated\\n- current store backing is volatile and is not a production durability claim\\n\\nThis issue does **not** authorize activation.\\n\\n## Required vendor / IDE evidence\\n\\n### 1. `CheckSum.CRC32` golden fixture\\n\\nCapture exact LASAL/vendor CRC semantics from the real target/toolchain. Preserve enough golden vectors to distinguish at least:\\n\\n- empty input handling if supported;\\n- zero-filled blocks;\\n- nonzero deterministic byte sequence;\\n- exact 64-byte SetPosition store header candidate with CRC field zeroed;\\n- exact 1344-byte ledger/body candidate.\\n\\nRecord input bytes/length, returned CRC, target/library identity and the code path used. Do not substitute an assumed IEEE CRC32 implementation merely because the name is `CRC32`.\\n\\nThe host image generator `tools/Generate-LmcSetPositionStoreImages.ps1` must remain blocked until these fixtures exist and are reviewed.\\n\\n### 2. LASAL IDE-generated `_FileSys` class/client ABI\\n\\nCreate the SetPosition file-backend class and required `_FileSys` client/channel in LASAL IDE/CodeGenerator, then capture the generated declaration/source/project/network delta. Do not hand-author generated declaration ABI in GitHub.\\n\\nRequired target files include the design-listed SetPosition store class/project/network surfaces. The exact generated method/channel ABI must be reviewed before handwritten backend logic is attached.\\n\\n### 3. Fresh C78/artifact checkpoint\\n\\nOn one exact source tree after the IDE-generated ABI exists:\\n\\n- fresh C78/ARM Rebuild + Link;\\n- zero errors and no new `CInvalidArgException`;\\n- generated artifact identities recorded and explicitly reviewed;\\n- full SourceOnly rerun without blindly ratcheting `Classes.lcb` identity.\\n\\n## Factory deployment boundary\\n\\nSP-01 host receipt/deployment-chain tooling may be implemented independently because it can validate manifest/readback SHA-256 and manufacturing provenance without calculating the vendor CRC. Values must be backed by project wiring/drive documentation or measured qualification evidence; they must not be inferred from generic LMC defaults.\\n\\n## Axis 1..4 approval checklist\\nFor **each physical axis 1, 2, 3, 4** resolve and approve:\\n\\n### HOMEEX-01 wiring / homing method\\n- [ ] Home switch source\\n- [ ] Positive-limit source\\n- [ ] Negative-limit source\\n- [ ] Index source\\n- [ ] Block/detection source when applicable\\n- [ ] Active level / polarity\\n- [ ] Input debounce/filter time\\n- [ ] Permitted travel direction\\n- [ ] Maximum homing travel\\n- [ ] Standard DS402 homing method allowlist (subset of v1 candidates `1..14`, `17..30`, `33..34`)\\n\\n### HOMEEX-02 scale / range\\n- [ ] Position scale\\n- [ ] Velocity scale\\n- [ ] Acceleration scale\\n- [ ] Torque scale\\n- [ ] Rounding rule\\n- [ ] Converted DINT minimum/maximum and overflow behavior\\n- [ ] Confirm `ActualPosition == -Position` final-position convention for the approved profile\\n\\n### Vendor-specific optional fields\\nFor each of DetectionVelocityLimit, DistanceLimit and TorqueLimit:\\n- [ ] either explicitly disabled for the approved methods (wire value must remain zero), or\\n- [ ] object mapping + scale + range + fault behavior explicitly approved\\n\\n### Revision / evidence\\n- [ ] Attach or reference the wiring/drive/profile evidence used for the approval\\n- [ ] Pair any scale/allowlist change with a Diagnostics `MapRevision` increase\\n- [ ] Update `docs/api/design/HOME_DS402_EX_AXIS_PROFILE.json` from `pending` to `approved`\\n- [ ] Run `tools/Verify-HomeDs402ExAxisProfile.ps1 -ExpectedState Approved`\\n\\n## Current software boundary\\nPR #27 provides the fail-closed HOMEEX-01/02 manifest and verifier. Its pending profile passes 105 structural checks and is intentionally rejected by the Approved gate.\\n\\nUntil this issue is completed:\\n- HOMEEX-08 SDO/runtime execution stays closed\\n- 완료)\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"labels\":[],\"state\":\"open\",\"locked\":false,\"assignees\":[],\"milestone\":null,\"comments\":14,\"created_at\":\"2026-08-27T04:38:41Z\",\"updated_at\":\"2026-09-01T02:18:31Z\",\"closed_at\":null,\"assignee\":null,\"author_association\":\"OWNER\",\"active_lock_reason\":null,\"sub_issues_summary\":{\"total\":0,\"completed\":0,\"percent_completed\":0},\"issue_dependencies_summary\":{\"blocked_by\":0,\"total_blocked_by\":0,\"blocking\":0,\"total_blocking\":0},\"body\":\"## Current status — 2026-09-01\\n\\nSetOperationMode 범위는 `dev@0afbc2a79dff1b63f908b1bde3bd2502843045ff` (`dev : SetOpMode Complete`)에서 구현 완료로 닫았다. 이 issue는 이제 **Generic SDO 잔여 범위만** 추적한다.\\n\\nCurrent source에 통합된 범위:\\n\\n- Manual Server + tokenized programmatic dual-entry 기반\\n- physical axis 1..4 generic 1/2/4-byte scalar Write policy\\n- WPF arbitrary target editor / exact request preview / reserved warning\\n- exact durable request journal + terminal/readback + no automatic replay recovery\\n- ordinary Write safe-state gate: Standstill / no Fault / not OperationEnabled\\n- Axis1 `0x2F00:24`는 qualification preset으로만 유지\\n\\nraw Generic SDO에서 계속 차단하는 semantic/dedicated-owner object:\\n\\n```text\\n0x6040\\n0x6060\\n0x607A\\n0x60FF\\n0x6071\\n0x3204\\n0x20FC\\n```\\n\\n## Remaining P0 completion conditions\\n\\n1. Axis1 safe non-semantic 1/2/4-byte object의 실제 Write + exact readback PASS\\n2. LASAL Class View `ParaReadWrite=0/1` manual Read/Write 실제 동작 확인\\n3. manual/programmatic 동시 접근 BUSY 직렬화, race/no hidden write 확인\\n4. timeout/disconnect/readback mismatch에서 exact durable no-replay recovery 확인\\n5. Axis2..4 generic scalar Write/readback matrix 확대\\n6. 동일 source/artifact/image 기준으로 WPF/SDK/manual qualification evidence 정리\\n\\nuncertain mutation의 automatic replay는 계속 0회여야 한다. raw `0x6060`은 SetOperationMode 전용 owner가 소유하므로 Generic SDO에서 열지 않는다.\\n\\n## Documentation\\n\\n- `docs/api/design/DEVELOPMENT_STATUS_20260901.md` — current 전체 개발 순서\\n- `docs/api/API_DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md` — current 구현률/우선순위\\n- `docs/api/API_MANUAL.md` — public/current API 계약\\n- `docs/api/design/SDO_OPERATION_MODE_REIMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_20260827.md` — historical redesign plan\\n\\n## Historical origin\\n\\n2026-08-27에는 Generic SDO가 Axis1 `0x2F00:24` 한 target에 사실상 제한되고 SetOperationMode loaded runtime과 UI 계약도 일치하지 않아 두 기능을 함께 재설계 대상으로 열었다. SetOperationMode는 이후 PP/PV/IP/CSP exact requested-mode lifecycle, one-shot `0x6060`, read-only settling, durable outcome/retire/no-replay까지 완료됐으므로 이 issue의 current scope에서 제외한다.\\n\\n전체 API production release는 이 issue 하나와 별개이며 HomeDS402, HomeDS402Ex, SetPosition 및 dormant/missing surface까지 release gate가 닫혀야 한다.\",\"closed_by\":null,\"reactions\":{\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/dreiven61/Elmo_Master/issues/46/reactions\",\"total_count\":0,\"+1\":0,\"-1\":0,\"laugh\":0,\"hooray\":0,\"confused\":0,\"heart\":0,\"rocket\":0,\"eyes\":0},\"timeline_url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/dreiven61/Elmo_Master/issues/46/timeline\",\"performed_via_github_app\":{\"id\":1144995,\"client_id\":\"Iv23liVemv8A9if9v0F2\",\"slug\":\"chatgpt-codex-connector\",\"node_id\":\"A_kwHOAOQ6Gs4AEXij\",\"owner\":{\"login\":\"openai\",\"id\":14957082,\"node_id\":\"MDEyOk9yZ2FuaXphdGlvbjE0OTU3MDgy\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/14957082?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/openai\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/received_events\",\"type\":\"Organization\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"name\":\"ChatGPT ABI\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"labels\":[],\"state\":\"open\",\"locked\":false,\"assignees\":[],\"milestone\":null,\"comments\":1,\"created_at\":\"2026-08-27T02:09:05Z\",\"updated_at\":\"2026-09-02T01:25:10Z\",\"closed_at\":null,\"assignee\":null,\"author_association\":\"OWNER\",\"active_lock_reason\":null,\"sub_issues_summary\":{\"total\":0,\"completed\":0,\"percent_completed\":0},\"issue_dependencies_summary\":{\"blocked_by\":0,\"total_blocked_by\":0,\"blocking\":0,\"total_blocking\":0},\"body\":\"## Purpose\\n\\nClose the external prerequisites that must exist before SetPosition SP-01B durable A/B storage can be implemented/qualified without guessing vendor behavior or hand-editing generated LASAL ABI.\\n\\n## Current production boundary\\n\\nCurrent `dev` SetPosition remains Dormant:\\n\\n- `LMC_ADMIN_SET_POSITION_STORE_CONFIGURED = FALSE`\\n- ordinary ownership activation OFF\\n- axis 1..4 max-jump values remain 0\\n- Admin capability bits 3/5/7 OFF\\n- native SetPosition execution not activated\\n- current store backing is volatile and is not a production durability claim\\n\\nThis issue does **not** authorize activation.\\n\\n## Required vendor / IDE evidence\\n\\n### 1. `CheckSum.CRC32` golden fixture\\n\\nCapture exact LASAL/vendor CRC semantics from the real target/toolchain. Preserve enough golden vectors to distinguish at least:\\n\\n- empty input handling if supported;\\n- zero-filled blocks;\\n- nonzero deterministic byte sequence;\\n- exact 64-byte SetPosition store header candidate with CRC field zeroed;\\n- exact 1344-byte ledger/body candidate.\\n\\nRecord input bytes/length, returned CRC, target/library identity and the code path used. Do not substitute an assumed IEEE CRC32 implementation merely because the name is `CRC32`.\\n\\nThe host image generator `tools/Generate-LmcSetPositionStoreImages.ps1` must remain blocked until these fixtures exist and are reviewed.\\n\\n### 2. LASAL IDE-generated `_FileSys` class/client ABI\\n\\nCreate the SetPosition file-backend class and required `_FileSys` client/channel in LASAL IDE/CodeGenerator, then capture the generated declaration/source/project/network delta. Do not hand-author generated declaration ABI in GitHub.\\n\\nRequired target files include the design-listed SetPosition store class/project/network surfaces. The exact generated method/channel ABI must be reviewed before handwritten backend logic is attached.\\n\\n### 3. Fresh C78/artifact checkpoint\\n\\nOn one exact source tree after the IDE-generated ABI exists:\\n\\n- fresh C78/ARM Rebuild + Link;\\n- zero errors and no new `CInvalidArgException`;\\n- generated artifact identities recorded and explicitly reviewed;\\n- full SourceOnly rerun without blindly ratcheting `Classes.lcb` identity.\\n\\n## Factory deployment boundary\\n\\nSP-01 host receipt/deployment-chain tooling may be implemented independently because it can validate manifest/readback SHA-256 and manufacturing provenance without calculating the vendor CRC. That tooling does **not** complete SP-01B.\\n\\nActual factory deployment still requires:\\n\\n- PLC application STOPPED and project unloaded;\\n- LASAL CLASS 2 `Debug -> File Transfer` upload/readback evidence;\\n- exact 2,048-byte A/B image readback and manifest SHA-256 match;\\n- valid append-only `FactoryNew -> FactoryInstallStarted -> VerifiedFactoryEmpty` receipt chain;\\n- cold power-cycle/reopen validation after runtime backend exists.\\n\\n## Completion\\n\\nDo not close this issue until vendor CRC golden vectors and the IDE-generated `_FileSys` ABI are both captured/reviewed and the same-tree C78/generated-artifact checkpoint is green. Production SetPosition capability/runtime remains OFF after issue closure until SP-01C/SP-02/SP-03/SP-04/SP-05/SP-06 gates independently pass.\",\"closed_by\":null,\"reactions\":{\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/dreiven61/Elmo_Master/issues/44/reactions\",\"total_count\":0,\"+1\":0,\"-1\":0,\"laugh\":0,\"hooray\":0,\"confused\":0,\"heart\":0,\"rocket\":0,\"eyes\":0},\"timeline_url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/dreiven61/Elmo_Master/issues/44/timeline\",\"performed_via_github_app\":{\"id\":1144995,\"client_id\":\"Iv23liVemv8A9if9v0F2\",\"slug\":\"chatgpt-codex-connector\",\"node_id\":\"A_kwHOAOQ6Gs4AEXij\",\"owner\":{\"login\":\"openai\",\"id\":14957082,\"node_id\":\"MDEyOk9yZ2FuaXphdGlvbjE0OTU3MDgy\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/14957082?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/openai\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/openai/received_events\",\"type\":\"Organization\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"name\":\"ChatGPT ratchet\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"labels\":[],\"state\":\"open\",\"locked\":false,\"assignees\":[],\"milestone\":null,\"comments\":0,\"created_at\":\"2026-08-26T06:34:14Z\",\"updated_at\":\"2026-08-26T06:34:14Z\",\"closed_at\":null,\"assignee\":null,\"author_association\":\"OWNER\",\"active_lock_reason\":null,\"sub_issues_summary\":{\"total\":0,\"completed\":0,\"percent_completed\":0},\"issue_dependencies_summary\":{\"blocked_by\":0,\"total_blocked_by\":0,\"blocking\":0,\"total_blocking\":0},\"body\":\"## Blocker\\n\\nHomeDS402Ex HOMEEX-05/07/09 software/static qualification is green on `dev`, but HOMEEX-09 cannot be considered complete while full repository SourceOnly reaches the generated LASAL artifact boundary:\\n\\n`LASAL.UdpCallbackContract blocker: SetPosition-augmented Classes.lcb physical identity drifted.`\\n\\nThis is an artifact freshness/identity boundary. Do not relax or blindly ratchet the expected physical identity.\\n\\n## Current software baseline\\n\\n- `dev` includes PR #33 HOMEEX-05 retained outcome store and exact 176-byte Retire retry semantics.\\n- `dev` includes PR #34 `tools/Capture-HomeDs402ExC78Evidence.ps1` and its fail-closed CI.\\n- `LMC_DIAG_DS402_HOME_EX_ENABLED` remains `FALSE`.\\n- Admin capability bit 11 remains OFF.\\n- issue #28 still blocks HOMEEX-01/02 real wiring/scale/profile approval.\\n\\n## Required fresh LASAL evidence\\n\\nUse one exact source tree/commit and record `BuildStartedUtc` before the rebuild.\\n\\n1. LASAL C78/ARM Rebuild + Link with explicit zero errors and no `CInvalidArgException`.\\n2. Confirm these generated artifacts are newer than `BuildStartedUtc`:\\n   - `Lasal_PRG/Elmo_EtherCAT_Test_4Axis/Class/Classes.lcb`\\n   - `Lasal_PRG/Elmo_EtherCAT_Test_4Axis/Elmo_EtherCAT_Test_4Axis.lcb`\\n   - `Lasal_PRG/Elmo_EtherCAT_Test_4Axis/Network/Networks.lcb`\\n3. Direct-open PASS evidence for:\\n   - `LMCDiagnosticsService::HandleAxisDs402HomeExStart`\\n   - `LMCDiagnosticsService::HandleAxisDs402HomeExOutcome`\\n   - `LMCDiagnosticsService::HandleAxisDs402HomeExRetire`\\n   - `LMCDiagnosticsService::ProcessAxisDs402HomeEx`\\n4. Network smoke PASS evidence for:\\n   - `TCPMotionInterface`\\n   - `LMCControlCommandService`\\n   - `LMCDiagnosticsService`\\n   - `LMCEcatInputLatch`\\n\\n## Evidence capture\\n\\nRun the merged collector against those real files, for example:\\n\\n```powershell\\n.\\\\tools\\\\Capture-HomeDs402ExC78Evidence.ps1 `\\n  -RepositoryRoot <repo-root> `\\n  -BuildLogPath <c78-build.log> `\\n  -MethodDirectOpenEvidencePath <homeex-direct-open.log> `\\n  -NetworkSmokeEvidencePath <network-smoke.log> `\\n  -OutputPath <homeex-c78-evidence.md> `\\n  -BuildStartedUtc <recorded-utc>\\n```\\n\\nThe collector must produce `CAPTURED_FOR_REVIEW`, not an automatic approval. Scope\\n\\nQualify the dynamic SetOperationMode/HomeDS402Ex recovery-panel localization that is already present on current `dev`.\\n\\n## Change\\n\\nStrengthen `RecentRecoveryPanelLocalizationTests` so the Korean -> English -> Korean round trip covers actual dynamically created content, not only group headers:\\n\\n- SetOperationMode axis/CSP labels\\n- SetOperationMode capability/recovery buttons\\n- HomeDS402Ex warning text\\n- HomeDS402Ex capability/recovery buttons\\n\\n## Why\\n\\nThe current `dev` localization fix was applied directly and therefore did not produce GitHub Actions runs. This PR changes only the focused regression test so both existing WPF recovery workflows are triggered against the exact current `dev` implementation.\\n\\n## Boundary\\n\\n- test-only change\\n- no SDK/protocol change\\n- no LASAL/PLC change\\n- no recovery lifecycle change\\n- no capability activation\\n- no HomeDS402Ex hardware/profile values inferred\\n\\n## Qualification\\n\\nHead `478fb2bd64279cd4f2f7c8a8c5d86624cc39fff3`:\\n\\n- SetOperationMode WPF recovery run `33026189333`: **SUCCESS**\\n  - Debug build/test PASS\\n  - Release build/test PASS\\n  - diff hygiene PASS\\n- HomeDS402Ex WPF recovery run `33026189342`: **SUCCESS**\\n  - Debug build/test PASS\\n  - Release build/test PASS\\n  - diff hygiene PASS\\n\\nThis closes the GitHub Actions evidence gap for the recovery\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## Scope\\n\\nImplement SetPosition SP-04A durable WPF no-replay recovery on current `dev` without enabling SetPosition production activation.\\n\\n## Implemented\\n\\n- dynamic SetPosition durable-recovery panel\\n- exact SetPosition recovery identity persisted before the one-shot `0x7D12` write boundary\\n- startup/reopen promotion `ArmedBeforeDispatch -> RecoveryRequired`\\n- unresolved-record endpoint/mutation interlock\\n- recovery sends only exact `0x7D14 ReadOutcome` and generation-bound `0x7D1A Retire`\\n- durable terminal proof before retirement\\n- original `0x7D12 Start` is never reconstructed or replayed by recovery\\n- successful SetPosition outcome-query result treated as terminal (`Succeeded` or `Rejected`)\\n- lifecycle-safe journal ownership: initialization is idempotent and the SetPosition recovery journal lock is released from the real WPF `Window.Closed` path\\n- focused smoke test proves a shown/loaded hidden MainWindow can close and immediately reopen the exact SetPosition journal lock\\n\\n## Final qualification head\\n\\n`573f3621e2e6d0f3495e37752d8aa72cd9e17b4c`\\n\\nGreen workflows on this head:\\n\\n- SetPosition WPF recovery `33032199842`: SUCCESS\\n  - Debug build/smoke PASS\\n  - Release build/smoke PASS\\n  - 14 SetPosition tests including startup promotion, dormant capability fail-closed, and Window.Close lock-release PASS\\n  - diff hygiene PASS\\n- SetOperationMode WPF recovery `33032199802`: SUCCESS\\n- HomeDS402Ex WPF recovery `33032199795`: SUCCESS\\n- HomeDS402 H37 source qualification `33032199777`: SUCCESS\\n  - activation/ownership/method-size/no-replay source checks PASS\\n  - API Debug/Release PASS\\n  - H37 WPF Debug/Release PASS\\n  - full SourceOnly reaches and classifies the existing exact generated-artifact boundary as designed\\n  - diff hygiene PASS\\n\\n## Activation boundary\\n\\nThis PR does **not** enable SetPosition. Production gates remain unchanged:\\n\\n- Store configured: OFF\\n- ordinary ownership: OFF\\n- per-axis max jump: 0\\n- Admin bits 3/5/7: OFF\\n- native SetPosition execution: not activated\\n\\nThe Start control remains fail-closed unless a future approved PLC advertises the full SetPosition/Outcome/Retire capability triad and all independent gates pass.\\n\\n## Deliberate exclusions / next tranche\\n\\n- no `_FileSys` A/B runtime backend yet\\n- no guessed vendor `CheckSum.CRC32`\\n- no hand-authored LASAL generated class/client ABI\\n- no RT native exactly-once implementation\\n- no C78/PLC/hardware SetPosition evidence\\n- no capability activation\\n\\nIssue #44 now tracks the vendor CRC golden fixture plus LASAL IDE-generated `_FileSys` ABI prerequisite. gate\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## Scope\\n\\nImplement the GitHub/host-side portion of SetPosition SP-01B factory provisioning without guessing vendor CRC behavior or hand-authoring LASAL generated `_FileSys` ABI.\\n\\n## Added\\n\\n- `tools/LmcSetPositionStoreDeploymentReceipt.ps1`\\n  - frozen manifest schema for controller/source/image identity\\n  - exact 2,048-byte A/B bundle checks\\n  - canonical UTF-8/LF JSONL receipt records\\n  - SHA-256 predecessor chaining\\n  - monotonic `FactoryNew -> FactoryInstallStarted -> VerifiedFactoryEmpty -> ActivationAuthorized -> Activated` state validation\\n  - append-only lock and fail-closed tamper detection\\n  - interrupted `FactoryInstallStarted` resume without duplicate append\\n- `tools/Start-LmcSetPositionStoreDeployment.ps1`\\n  - requires external inventory `FactoryNew` receipt\\n  - verifies bundle/serial/source identity and non-empty STOP/unload evidence\\n  - appends only `FactoryInstallStarted`\\n  - performs no PLC transfer or activation\\n- `tools/Verify-LmcSetPositionStoreDeployment.ps1`\\n  - verifies LASAL File Transfer readback A/B exact length/SHA/byte identity\\n  - requires exact two-record predecessor chain and same STOP evidence\\n  - appends only `VerifiedFactoryEmpty`\\n  - duplicate verification is rejected\\n- design/runbook for manual LASAL CLASS 2 `Debug -> File Transfer`\\n- Windows PowerShell 5.1 self-test workflow\\n\\n## Deliberate boundary\\n\\nThe synthetic CI images test only host manifest/receipt behavior. They are **not** valid SetPosition store-image evidence.\\n\\nStill blocked by issue #44:\\n\\n- vendor `CheckSum.CRC32` golden fixture\\n- host `Generate-LmcSetPositionStoreImages.ps1`\\n- LASAL IDE-generated `_FileSys` class/client ABI\\n- real runtime A/B header/body CRC, marker-last commit, reopen/readback, cold restart\\n\\nThis PR changes no LASAL runtime source and does not enable Store configured, ordinary ownership, Admin bits 3/5/7, max-jump, or native SetPosition add PLC-advertised SetOperationMode supported-mode mask\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## 목적\\n\\ncurrent `dev` (PR #47 LMCSdoExecutor dual-entry 포함) 위에서 SetOperationMode multi-mode software path와 PLC-advertised SupportedModeMask를 통합합니다. 이 PR은 old PR #48을 대체합니다.\\n\\n## 구현\\n\\n- software target: PP(1), PV(3), IP(7), CSP(8)\\n- Homing(6)은 HomeDS402/HomeDS402Ex 소유로 계속 거부\\n- AdminCapabilities 기존 40-byte payload 유지\\n  - 기존 final reserved UInt16을 `SetOperationModeSupportedMask`로 승격\\n  - bit N = positive DS402 mode N\\n  - known software mask = `0x018A` (1/3/7/8)\\n- fail-closed capability coupling\\n  - bits 8/9/10 OFF -> mask 반드시 0\\n  - exact triad ON -> mask nonzero + known subset 필요\\n- SDK `PrepareAxisSetOperationMode`는 current capability observation이 요청 mode를 광고하지 않으면 wire 전에 거부\\n- WPF selector는 hard-coded list가 아니라 `PLC mask ∩ {PP,PV,IP,CSP}`만 표시\\n  - capability 관측 전 selector empty/disabled\\n  - selected mode가 refresh 후 사라지면 Start zero-wire 차단\\n- LASAL dormant runtime은 retained requested mode를 execution truth로 사용\\n  - same-mode zero-write\\n  - change-mode exact 1-byte `0x6060:0=requestedMode`\\n  - recovery는 retained requested mode 복원, 0x6060 replay 없음\\n  - terminal verify는 `observedMode == requestedMode`\\n\\n## production boundary\\n\\n이 PR은 activation을 열지 않습니다.\\n\\n- `LMC_DIAG_SET_OPERATION_MODE_ENABLED = FALSE`\\n- Admin feature mask = `0x00000017`\\n- bits 8/9/10 OFF\\n- 따라서 production/current dormant PLC가 광고하는 `SetOperationModeSupportedMask = 0`\\n- generated artifact/C78/PLC/hardware PASS를 주장하지 않음\\n\\n## 진행도\\n\\nSetOperationMode release-oriented progress: **65% -> 70%**\\n\\n70% 의미:\\n- lifecycle / owner / durable no-replay recovery 완료\\n- LMCSdoExecutor dual-entry가 current dev에 통합됨\\n- PP/PV/IP/CSP software path 완료\\n- PLC-advertised mode mask + SDK/WPF fail-closed intersection 구현\\n\\n남은 gate:\\n1. current exact-source fresh C78/ARM + generated artifact review\\n2. bench activation에서 triad + `0x018A` paired advertisement 확인\\n3. Axis1 PP/PV/IP/CSP same-mode/cross-mode packet evidence\\n4. MODE-12 timeout/disconnect/quarantine/recovery matrix\\n5. Axis2..4 matrix\\n6. qualification\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## 목적\\n\\nSetOperationMode 요청 mode 콤보박스가 PLC capability triad/mask가 아직 OFF인 경우 완전히 비활성화되어 qualification UX가 막히는 문제를 수정합니다.\\n\\n## 변경\\n\\n- selector는 software-known target PP(1), PV(3), IP(7), CSP(8)를 항상 표시\\n- selector 자체는 idle/no-active-recovery 상태에서 PLC mask와 무관하게 선택 가능\\n- 실제 Start는 기존과 동일하게 다음 조건을 모두 요구\\n  - Admin bits 8/9/10 triad\\n  - selected mode가 PLC `SetOperationModeSupportedMask`에 포함\\n  - stable DiagnosticsBuild/BootId/MapRevision\\n  - explicit one-shot confirmation\\n  - durable journal/admission gate\\n- Start 직전 AdminCapabilities를 다시 읽고 선택 mode가 더 이상 광고되지 않으면 zero-wire로 거부\\n- 회귀 테스트를 `selector usable / Start fail-closed` 계약으로 갱신\\n\\n## 안전 경계\\n\\n이 PR은 PLC activation을 변경하지 않습니다. `dev`의 SetOperationMode runtime gate와 Admin bits 8/9/10은 계속 OFF입니다. qualification branch의 두-line activation delta도 별도로 유지합니다.\\n\\nTracking: 목적\\n\\n`SET_OPERATION_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION_UPDATE_20260828.md`의 MODE-11F를 구현합니다.\\n\\n## 구현\\n\\n- definitive Start rejection 로그에 requested mode, axis, request id, status, ErrorId, symbolic/numeric DetailCode, Build/Boot/Map 표시\\n- terminal outcome 로그/상태에 requested/preflight(previous)/observed mode 표시\\n- DS402 StatusWord에서 Fault / OperationEnabled를 명시적으로 표시\\n- ContextCheck에서 PhysicalValid를 표시\\n- EvidenceFlags에서 WriteRequested / WriteDispatched / VerifyReadDispatched / VerifyReadCompleted / OwnerReleased / ExecutorReusable를 개별 표시\\n- quarantine reason / record generation 표시\\n- 현재 outcome wire에 Standstill 원본 axis-status가 없으므로 `Standstill=not-exported`로 명시하고 추정하지 않음\\n- durable recovery record terminal 요약에도 preflight/observed/detail/DS402/evidence 추가\\n- qualification selector 문구와 한국어 localization round-trip을 현재 UX 계약과 동기화\\n- 신규 WPF smoke로 UNSAFE(44), OperationEnabled, no-write evidence 표시를 고정\\n\\n## Safety boundary\\n\\n- wire schema 변경 없음\\n- Start/recovery/no-replay 목적\\n\\n`SET_OPERATION_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION_UPDATE_20260828.md`의 다음 구현 gate인 MODE-11E를 반영합니다.\\n\\n## 구현\\n\\n- warm-start recovery candidate를 CSP(8) only에서 PP(1)/PV(3)/IP(7)/CSP(8)로 일반화\\n- non-CSP candidate는 `LMC_DIAG_SET_OPERATION_MODE_SOFTWARE_MODES` loaded-image gate를 따름\\n- retained record generation + admission/owner/session/sequence identity를 모두 nonzero fence로 강화\\n- retained Running candidate가 둘 이상이면 첫 candidate로 staging한 runtime 영역도 즉시 clear하고 fail-closed\\n- recovery helper의 `0x6060` write site 0개/no-replay 계약 유지\\n- static verifier에 MODE-11E exact candidate/identity/multi-candidate regression 추가\\n\\n## Activation boundary\\n\\n- `LMC_DIAG_SET_OPERATION_MODE_ENABLED = FALSE` 유지\\n- Admin bits 8/9/10 OFF 유지\\n- production supported-mode mask 0 유지\\n- C78/PLC/hardware qualification을 주장하지 않음\\n\\nTracking: path\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## 목적\\n\\nPR #18 `codex/setopmode-mode11-bench-activation`에 있던 SetOperationMode multi-mode software 구현을 current `dev` 기준 구현 단계로 올립니다.\\n\\n## 통합 범위\\n\\n- SDK request allow-list: PP(1), PV(3), IP(7), CSP(8)\\n- Homing(6)은 계속 HomeDS402/HomeDS402Ex 전용으로 거부\\n- LASAL dormant runtime에서 requested mode를 retained execution truth로 사용\\n  - same-mode: `0x6061 == requestedMode`이면 zero-write\\n  - change-mode: exact one-byte `0x6060:0=requestedMode`\\n  - recovery: retained requested mode 복구, `0x6060` replay 없음\\n  - terminal success: observed mode == requested mode\\n- WPF requested-mode selector: PP/PV/IP/CSP\\n- SDK/WPF regression tests\\n- 설계/진행도 문서 60% -> 65%\\n\\n## PR #18 merge resolution\\n\\n이 branch에는 PR #18 head `f1c717518cec9a6eee750094339e3ef8b275f7f6`가 merge parent로 연결되어 있습니다.\\nqualification-only activation은 최종 tree에 포함하지 않았습니다.\\n\\n### production gate 유지\\n\\n- `LMC_DIAG_SET_OPERATION_MODE_ENABLED = FALSE`\\n- Admin mask = `0x00000017`\\n- SetOperationMode bits 8/9/10 = OFF\\n- stale generated `Classes.lcb` / project artifact는 가져오지 않음\\n\\n즉 **software implementation은 current-dev 통합 후보로 승격하지만 production activation은 열지 않습니다.**\\n\\n## 진행도\\n\\nSetOperationMode release-oriented progress: **60% -> 65%**\\n\\n65%의 의미:\\n\\n- lifecycle / exact identity / owner / no-replay / recovery / WPF durable journal 완료\\n- PP/PV/IP/CSP software target path 구현 완료\\n- production SupportedModeMask는 아직 미구현\\n- fresh current-tree C78/generated artifact, PLC load, MODE-11/12 hardware matrix는 미완료\\n- MODE-14 activation 미완료\\n\\n## 다음 gate\\n\\n1. PLC-advertised SupportedModeMask + WPF intersection/fail-closed\\n2. fresh exact-source C78/ARM + generated artifact review\\n3. Axis1 PP/PV/IP/CSP same-mode/cross-mode packet evidence\\n4. MODE-12 timeout/disconnect/quarantine/recovery matrix\\n5. Axis2..4 확장\\n6. 목적\\n\\nPR #52(MODE-11E)와 PR #53(MODE-11F) merge 이후 SetOperationMode 설계문서를 current `dev@45fc528c48723cbe3ba20fb11c3a2d7ec0e7ef0b` 기준으로 동기화합니다.\\n\\n## 반영 내용\\n\\n- MODE-11E PP/PV/IP/CSP warm-start recovery를 완료 처리\\n- MODE-11F WPF rejection/preflight/write-evidence diagnostics를 완료 처리\\n- source/PC 구현 진행도 약 80%, release-oriented 약 65%로 분리\\n- production activation OFF / bits8-10 OFF / production mask 0 유지\\n- 기존 qualification branch `eae31dd...`가 current dev와 diverged한 사실 및 다음 실기 전 재생성 필요 명시\\n- current dev 기준 qualification branch 재생성 → fresh C78/PLC → Axis1 PP/PV/IP matrix → failure/recovery matrix → MODE-11G mask coupling → Axis2..4 → MODE-14 순서 고정\\n- MODE-11F 로그 판정 규칙과 `Standstill=not-exported` 경계 명시\\n- `docs/api/design/README.md` SetOperationMode dashboard를 동일 상태로 동기화\\n\\n## Safety boundary\\n\\n문서 2개만 변경합니다. 목적\\n\\n2026-08-28 current `dev`와 qualification 결과를 기준으로 SetOperationMode 구현 설계를 보완합니다.\\n\\n## 핵심 보완\\n\\n- PP/PV/IP/CSP normal mutation path와 실제 qualification 상태 분리\\n- CSP same-mode가 쉽게 성공하고 non-CSP cross-mode가 safe-state preflight를 요구하는 이유 명시\\n- warm-start recovery의 `requestedMode == 8` CSP-only 잔존 결함 명시\\n- `SupportedModeMask`를 loaded-image enable mask와 production physical qualification으로 구분\\n- selector UX와 Start fail-closed admission 계약 정리\\n- MODE-11A~G 세부 gate와 Axis1 physical matrix 추가\\n- source/PC 70% / release-oriented 60% 진행도 분리\\n- production activation OFF 경계 draft tuples\\n- canonical little-endian WriteData preview\\n- semantic/dedicated-owner reserved Write warning with explicit `NOT SUBMITTED`\\n- preview uses the same `LMCDiagnosticsWritePolicy` boundary as submission\\n- Korean static label catalog entry\\n- focused smoke assertions and source verifier\\n- R04 design checklist synchronized to implemented state\\n\\n## Validation\\nGitHub Actions promotion run `33147933718`:\\n- focused source verifier: PASS\\n- Debug build: PASS, 0 errors\\n- Generic SDO targeted smoke: 17/17 PASS\\n- static localization catalog coverage: PASS\\n- localization service English->Korean->English round-trip: PASS\\n- Release build: PASS, 0 errors\\n- `git diff --check`: PASS\\n\\nThe repository-wide WPF suite has unrelated pre-existing `dev` failures in recovery-retirement/process-termination areas; this PR is gated by the R04-specific design checks above.\\n\\nProduction/PLC activation boundaries are policy\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## 목적\\n\\nissue #46의 SDO-R03을 current `dev` 기준으로 구현한다. 사용자가 별도로 진행 중인 SetOperationMode physical/functional qualification과 충돌하지 않도록 Generic D5 SDO Write policy만 변경한다.\\n\\n## 구현\\n\\n- 기존 Axis1 `0x2F00:24` exact-address allowlist를 generic address admission에서 제거\\n- `0x2F00:24`는 engineering/qualification preset과 conservative range guard로 유지\\n- physical axis 1..4에 대해 canonical scalar Write shape 지원\\n  - 8-bit types: 1 byte\\n  - 16-bit types: 2 bytes\\n  - 32-bit types: 4 bytes\\n- SDK `LMCSdoRequest.CreateWrite()`가 narrow 1/2-byte payload를 실제 wire width로 표현하도록 확장\\n- exact readback verification도 request ValueType의 canonical 1/2/4-byte width를 사용\\n- semantic/dedicated-owner raw Write는 계속 fail-closed\\n  - `0x6040`\\n  - `0x6060`\\n  - `0x607A`\\n  - `0x60FF`\\n  - `0x6071`\\n  - encoder-maintenance `0x3204`, `0x20FC`\\n- Bool raw value는 canonical 0/1만 허용\\n- PLC SDO Write capability는 UI[24] per-axis preset flag가 아니라 global policy gate에 연동\\n- focused static verifier 추가\\n\\n## 검증\\n\\nPromotion run `33143841950`:\\n\\n- R03 source promotion: PASS\\n- focused generic scalar Write source verifier: PASS\\n- SDK/API Debug build: PASS, 0 warnings / 0 errors\\n- full Debug contract suite: PASS\\n- Release build: PASS\\n- promotion commit: `60097a1cbcb0b2def9a54d089e8273f9502c8bc7`\\n\\n초기 회귀에서 permanently-unsafe public guard의 기존 `InvalidOperationException` 계약과 신규 test expectation이 3건 불일치했으나, runtime contract를 변경하지 않고 test를 기존 public fail-closed semantics에 맞춘 뒤 전체 green을 확보했다.\\n\\n## 범위 밖 / 후속\\n\\n이 PR만으로 hardware-qualified Generic SDO Write 또는 production release 완료로 판정하지 않는다.\\n\\n남은 단계:\\n\\n1. C78/LASAL generated artifact + PLC build/load qualification\\n2. physical safe-object 1/2/4-byte Write + exact readback\\n3. manual/programmatic arbitration / BUSY / no-wire regression\\n4. timeout/disconnect/readback mismatch durable recovery\\n5. SDO-R04 WPF arbitrary-target editor\\n6. SDO-R05 exact-request durable no-replay recovery\\n7. release/capability review\\n\\nSetOperationMode `0x6060` semantic lifecycle, capability bits 8/9/10 및 production SupportedModeMask는 변경하지 않는다.\",\"created_at\":\"2026-08-28T05:11:13Z\",\"updated_at\":\"2026-08-28T08:24:32Z\",\"closed_at\":\"2026-08-28T05:52:42Z\",\"merged_at\":\"2026-08-28T05:52:42Z\",\"merge_commit_sha\":\"25daa951c2feec947e82b70f3664bd918b5c5cfa\",\"assignees\":[],\"requested_reviewers\":[],\"requested_teams\":[],\"labels\":[],\"milestone\":null,\"draft\":true,\"commits_url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/dreiven61/Elmo_Master/pulls/55/commits\",\"review_comments_url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/dreiven61/Elmo_Master/pulls/55/comments\",\"review_comment_url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/dreiven61/Elmo_Master/pulls/comments{/number}\",\"comments_url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/dreiven61/Elmo_Master/issues/55/comments\",\"statuses_url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/dreiven61/Elmo_Master/statuses/25daa951c2feec947e82b70f3664bd918b5c5cfa\",\"head\":{\"label\":\"dreiven61:codex/sdo-r03-generic-write-current-dev\",\"ref\":\"codex/sdo-r03-generic-write-current-dev\",\"sha\":\"25daa951c2feec947e82b70f3664bd918b5c5cfa\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user redesign\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## 목적\\n\\n2026-08-27 bench에서 드러난 3개 문제를 재설계하고, 이후 사용자가 진행한 SDO-R02 구현/C78 작업까지 같은 branch에서 qualification합니다.\\n\\n요청한 기능:\\n\\n1. SetOperationMode PP/PV/IP/CSP 실제 전환\\n2. `0x2F00:24`에 한정되지 않는 Generic SDO Write\\n3. `LMCSdoExecutor`의 기존 `EtherCAT_SDOBase` manual Server Read/Write 복구\\n\\nTracking: #46\\n\\n## 2026-08-27 implementation audit\\n\\n### 1) SetOperationMode multi-mode — PARTIAL / NOT COMPLETE\\n\\n- 별도 MODE-11 qualification branch에는 PP(1)/PV(3)/IP(7)/CSP(8) request/UI가 존재합니다.\\n- 그러나 기존 bench Start는 definitive PLC rejection이었습니다.\\n- 이 PR에는 아직 PLC-advertised `SupportedModeMask`와 이를 사용하는 SDK/WPF selector가 없습니다.\\n- actual PP/PV/IP/CSP physical mode-change PASS도 없습니다.\\n\\n남은 gate: MODE-R01 -> MODE-R02.\\n\\n### 2) Generic arbitrary-target SDO Write — NOT IMPLEMENTED\\n\\n- `LMCSdoRequest`가 arbitrary object를 표현할 수 있는 regression test는 추가됐습니다.\\n- 그러나 `LMCDiagnosticsWritePolicy.AllowedSdoWrites` / `RequireSdoWriteAllowed()`는 아직 Axis1 `0x2F00:24 Int32/4` exact allowlist를 강제합니다.\\n- WPF arbitrary-target editor도 아직 없습니다.\\n\\n남은 gate: SDO-R03 -> SDO-R04 -> SDO-R05.\\n\\n### 3) LMCSdoExecutor manual Server — SOURCE IMPLEMENTED / BENCH OPEN\\n\\n구현됨:\\n\\n- `RequestSource` NONE/MANUAL_SERVER/PROGRAMMATIC arbitration\\n- manual `ParaReadWrite::Write` Read/Write dispatch\\n- `ParaType` / `ParaString` base-compatible behavior\\n- callback source dispatch and manual completion publication\\n- programmatic TryStartRead/TryStartWrite coexistence\\n- focused dual-entry source verifier\\n- generated LASAL artifacts\\n\\n현재 evidence:\\n\\n- C78/ARM Rebuild/Link: 0 errors, 101 warnings\\n- PLC download/basic runtime smoke: user-confirmed PASS\\n\\n아직 필요:\\n\\n- Axis1..4 executor direct-open\\n- manual `0x6061:0` Read\\n- safe manual Write + exact readback\\n- manual/programmatic BUSY/no-wire contention\\n- D5 programmatic regression\\n- same-image generated artifact identity closure\\n\\n## Updated design documents\\n\\n- `docs/architecture/LMC_GENERIC_SDO_AND_OPERATION_MODE_REDESIGN_2026-08-27.md`\\n- `docs/api/design/SDO_OPERATION_MODE_REIMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_20260827.md`\\n- `docs/api/design/DEVELOPMENT_STATUS_20260827.md`\\n- `docs/api/design/README.md`\\n- `docs/api/design/evidence/SDO_R02_C78_DOWNLOAD_SMOKE_20260827.md`\\n\\nThe documents now explicitly distinguish request-model support from actual submission policy, branch-local source implementation from physical qualification, and qualification branch code from current `dev` completion.\\n\\n## Current next order\\n\\n1. SDO-R02 manual Server physical qualification\\n2. SDO-R03 generic Write policy generalization\\n3. SDO-R04 arbitrary-target WPF editor\\n4. SDO-R05 exact-request durable no-replay recovery\\n5. MODE-R01 PLC SupportedModeMask + rejection diagnostics\\n6. MODE-R02 Axis1 PP/PV/IP/CSP matrix -> Axis2..4\\n7. REL-R01 distribution/docs/generated artifact closure\\n8. production activation in a separate review\\n\\n## Safety / release boundary\\n\\nThis PR does not authorize production activation.\\n\\n- production `dev` SetOperationMode gate/bits remain OFF\\n- no branch-local C78/basic PLC smoke is interpreted as multi-mode hardware PASS\\n- no arbitrary Generic Write is claimed until the compile-time target gate is actually removed and qualified\\n- uncertain mutation automatic replay remains prohibited\\n- generated artifact hash is not automatically ratcheted without same-image Scope\\n\\nPrepare the remaining HOMEEX-09 fresh C78/generated-artifact qualification boundary without changing HomeDS402Ex runtime or hardware profile values.\\n\\n## Added tooling\\n\\n`tools/Capture-HomeDs402ExC78Evidence.ps1` fail-closes unless one evidence set contains:\\n\\n- explicit `BuildStartedUtc`;\\n- fresh post-build `Class/Classes.lcb`, project `.lcb`, and `Network/Networks.lcb`;\\n- C78 + ARM build-log evidence;\\n- explicit zero-error compiler evidence;\\n- successful linker evidence;\\n- no `CInvalidArgException`;\\n- direct-open PASS for `HandleAxisDs402HomeExStart`, `HandleAxisDs402HomeExOutcome`, `HandleAxisDs402HomeExRetire`, and `ProcessAxisDs402HomeEx`;\\n- Network smoke PASS for TCPMotionInterface, LMCControlCommandService, LMCDiagnosticsService, and LMCEcatInputLatch;\\n- generated artifact size/mtime/SHA-256 plus HEAD/working blob identities;\\n- critical HomeDS402Ex source/verifier SHA-256 identities and working-tree state.\\n\\nThe receipt is intentionally `CAPTURED_FOR_REVIEW`. It keeps artifact ratchet review and full SourceOnly closure separate; it cannot approve a changed `Classes.lcb` identity by itself.\\n\\n## Self-test / regression boundary\\n\\nDedicated Windows CI self-tests:\\n\\n- successful synthetic fresh evidence capture;\\n- stale generated artifact rejection;\\n- incomplete HomeDS402Ex direct-open evidence rejection;\\n- HOMEEX-05 retained-store regression;\\n- HOMEEX-07 ownership regression;\\n- HOMEEX-09 source/static regression;\\n- `LMC_DIAG_DS402_HOME_EX_ENABLED FALSE`;\\n- Admin capability bit 11 OFF;\\n- diff hygiene.\\n\\n## Safety boundary\\n\\n- no LASAL functional runtime change in this PR;\\n- no hardware-dependent wiring/method/scale values are inferred;\\n- issue #28 remains required for HOMEEX-01/02 approval;\\n- HOMEEX-08 actual SDO/homing runtime remains OFF;\\n- Admin capability bit 11 remains OFF;\\n- this PR does not claim fresh real C78 evidence until the collector is run against a real LASAL rebuild tombstones\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## Scope\\n\\nImplement the hardware-independent HOMEEX-05 retained outcome-store semantics without enabling HomeDS402Ex physical execution.\\n\\n## Functional LASAL source change\\n\\n`Lasal_PRG/Elmo_EtherCAT_Test_4Axis/Class/LMCDiagnosticsService/LMCDiagnosticsService.st` now provides a 320-DINT HomeDS402Ex retained bank:\\n\\n- four 40-DINT active outcome records;\\n- four 40-DINT retired full-outcome records beginning at DINT 160;\\n- strict structural validation before any active or retired record is trusted;\\n- exact-key Outcome lookup with fixed 176-byte success serialization;\\n- exact-generation Retire;\\n- full retired outcome publication before the active record is cleared;\\n- 176-byte Retire success serialized from the retained retired record;\\n- idempotent exact Retire retry after response loss / active-record clear;\\n- duplicate Start blocking while an active record exists;\\n- replay blocking for the exact retired Start identity;\\n- terminal cleanup-proof gating using the frozen six-bit proof mask;\\n- fail-closed behavior for partial/corrupt retained state.\\n\\nThe lossy 24-DINT retired tombstone representation was removed because it could not satisfy the SDK Retire parser contract after response loss.\\n\\n## Current source / verifier head\\n\\nPR head: `3261156d275f867c9c5a5485c5fac8ee20ba79a6`\\n\\nFunctional source repair:\\n\\n- `0c4cf52984397ded250751f846a269a3d6e7b0cb` — `fix(homeex): return full retained outcome on retire`\\n\\nVerifier hardening:\\n\\n- `3261156d275f867c9c5a5485c5fac8ee20ba79a6` — explicitly pins the Retire cleanup-proof wire field at response offset `+168` in addition to generation `+164` and SDO executor token `+172`.\\n\\n## Qualification on current PR head\\n\\nAll PR-triggered workflows for `3261156d` completed successfully:\\n\\n- HOMEEX-05 retained store qualification — run `32937510017`: **SUCCESS**\\n  - retained-store verifier: **48 checks PASS**;\\n  - `HandleAxisDs402HomeExStart`: **11,570 bytes**;\\n  - `HandleAxisDs402HomeExOutcome`: **9,458 bytes**;\\n  - `HandleAxisDs402HomeExRetire`: **14,802 bytes**;\\n  - HOMEEX-09 source regression: **37/37 PASS**;\\n  - full SourceOnly reached the exact already-known generated-artifact boundary;\\n  - diff hygiene: PASS.\\n- HOMEEX-07 ownership qualification — run `32937510020`: **SUCCESS**.\\n- HOMEEX-09 static qualification — run `32937510050`: **SUCCESS**.\\n- HomeDS402Ex LASAL stage qualification — run `32937510039`: **SUCCESS**.\\n- SetOperationMode static qualification — run `32937510114`: **SUCCESS**.\\n- SetOperationMode C78 evidence tool — run `32937510135`: **SUCCESS**.\\n\\nThe exact SourceOnly boundary remains:\\n\\n`LASAL.UdpCallbackContract blocker: SetPosition-augmented Classes.lcb physical identity drifted.`\\n\\nThe HOMEEX-05 and SetOperationMode workflows classify only this already-known generated-artifact boundary separately from source/static qualification. This does **not** qualify or approve the tracked `Classes.lcb` artifact.\\n\\n## Safety boundary\\n\\nThis PR does **not** enable HomeDS402Ex motion/runtime execution:\\n\\n- `LMC_DIAG_DS402_HOME_EX_ENABLED` remains `FALSE`;\\n- `ProcessAxisDs402HomeEx` remains a physical-runtime no-op;\\n- no 0x6060/0x6061 mode programming;\\n- no homing parameter SDO program/restore;\\n- no controlword bit-4 execution;\\n- no RT owner acquisition/release;\\n- no hardware-dependent wiring/scale/profile values are inferred;\\n- Admin capability bit 11 remains OFF;\\n- issue #28 still blocks actual HOMEEX-01/02 hardware profile approval;\\n- fresh C78/generated-artifact qualification remains external/open.\\n\\n## HOMEEX-05 result\\n\\nThe retained-store, exact recovery-key, duplicate/replay blocking, full-outcome retirement, and exact Retire retry software semantics are qualified on the current PR head. Physical runtime, C78 artifact qualification, and hardware profile approval remain explicitly out of Scope\\n\\nQualify the existing HomeDS402 method-37 current-position-zero implementation without enabling production activation.\\n\\nThis PR collects the H37 source/static/PC/WPF qualification work currently staged on `codex/home-ds402-h37-source-qualification` and keeps the hardware/C78 boundaries explicit.\\n\\n## Qualified in software\\n\\n- H37-02 atomic 5-value activation contract: **43 checks PASS**; current capability mask remains `0x0000613F` and all activation gates remain OFF.\\n- H37-03 exact method-37 `0x7D15/0x7D16/0x7D17` Start/Running/terminal/retire PC sequence PASS; original Start is never replayed during recovery.\\n- H37-04 shared axis ownership/preemption regression: **21 checks PASS**.\\n- HomeDS402 LASAL method-size verifier: **10 checks PASS**; largest checked method is `LMCDiagnosticsService::ProcessAxisDs402Home` at 29497 bytes, below the 32768-byte limit.\\n- WPF durable-recovery source contract: **36 checks PASS**.\\n- API Debug full suite: **1194/1194 PASS**, 0 warnings, 0 errors.\\n- API Release full suite: **1194/1194 PASS**, 0 warnings, 0 errors.\\n- WPF Debug H37 smoke: MaintenanceJournal **9/9 PASS**, Ds402Home **10/10 PASS**.\\n- WPF Release H37 smoke: MaintenanceJournal **9/9 PASS**, Ds402Home **10/10 PASS**.\\n- Relaunch integration specifically verifies that an active DS402 Home durable journal reconstructs the exact recovery key immediately after WPF startup.\\n- H37-10 durable WPF recovery qualification is closed in the design checklist.\\n\\nLatest qualification evidence: workflow run `32932879122`, job `98068349746`.\\n\\n## Remaining blocker\\n\\nH37-05 is **not complete**. Full repository SourceOnly reaches the physical LASAL artifact ratchet and stops at:\\n\\n`LASAL.UdpCallbackContract blocker: SetPosition-augmented Classes.lcb physical identity drifted.`\\n\\nThis is not being papered over by changing the expected artifact identity. It requires a fresh LASAL C78 Rebuild/Link artifact and logs from the same source tree.\\n\\n## Still open / not claimed\\n\\n- H37-05 fresh SourceOnly closure with regenerated C78 artifact.\\n- H37-06 C78 Rebuild/Link, method direct-open and Network smoke.\\n- H37-07 Axis1 normal/timeout/fault/disconnect/response-loss hardware matrix.\\n- H37-08 Axis2-4 hardware matrix.\\n- H37-09 paired five-gate + Admin capability bit-6 activation.\\n- PLC download or physical hardware execution.\\n\\nAll HomeDS402 activation gates remain OFF. dev\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## Scope\\n\\nPort the hardware-independent HomeDS402 method-37 qualification tranche from stale Draft PR #31 onto current `dev` without enabling HomeDS402 production activation.\\n\\n## Current-dev integration\\n\\nThis PR intentionally transplants only the H37 software/source qualification pieces whose underlying files remained compatible with current `dev`:\\n\\n- H37 atomic five-value activation verifier\\n- H37 ownership/preemption regression verifier\\n- H37 LASAL method-size verifier\\n- H37 WPF durable no-replay verifier\\n- exact `0x7D15/0x7D16/0x7D17` PC packet/outcome/retire tests\\n- WPF startup reconstruction of an unresolved DS402 Home recovery key\\n- restart integration smoke coverage\\n- dedicated Windows qualification workflow\\n\\nStale docs and stale C78 collector state from PR #31 are **not** copied into this tranche.\\n\\n## Qualification\\n\\nHead `f39fe0e9b56b0994619aed3f68b22c33a86d3b24` — workflow run `33026506170`, successful rerun job `98369296568`:\\n\\n- H37 atomic activation contract: **43 checks PASS**\\n  - current Admin capability mask remains `0x0000613F`\\n  - HomeDS402 capability bit 6 remains OFF\\n- H37 ownership/preemption contract: **21 checks PASS**\\n- H37 method-size verifier: **10 checks PASS**\\n  - `HandleAxisDs402HomeStart`: 22,041 bytes\\n  - `HandleAxisDs402HomeOutcome`: 7,255 bytes\\n  - `HandleAxisDs402HomeRetire`: 4,221 bytes\\n  - `ProcessAxisDs402Home`: 29,497 bytes, below 32,768-byte limit\\n- H37 WPF durable no-replay source contract: **36 checks PASS**\\n- API Debug full suite: **PASS**\\n- API Release full suite: **PASS**\\n- WPF Debug `MaintenanceJournal` + `Ds402Home` smoke: **PASS**\\n- WPF Release `MaintenanceJournal` + `Ds402Home` smoke: **PASS**\\n- full SourceOnly reaches only the exact known generated-artifact boundary and is classified as source/static PASS:\\n  - `LASAL.UdpCallbackContract blocker: SetPosition-augmented Classes.lcb physical identity drifted.`\\n- `git diff --check`: **PASS**\\n\\nThe first workflow attempt passed all four H37 verifiers and then stopped only because the hosted Windows runner failed to locate MSBuild. No source workaround was added; the failed job was rerun on the identical head and completed successfully.\\n\\n## SourceOnly boundary\\n\\nReaching the known `Classes.lcb` boundary is **not** C78/generated-artifact approval. The artifact identity remains a separate review gate and is not automatically ratcheted by this PR.\\n\\n## Safety boundary\\n\\n- no LASAL HomeDS402 runtime source mutation\\n- all five HomeDS402 activation values remain OFF\\n- Admin HomeDS402 capability bit 6 remains OFF\\n- no C78 artifact ratchet update\\n- no PLC download/runtime claim\\n- no hardware/packet claim\\n- original Start is dev\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## Scope\\n\\nAdd the HomeDS402 H37 fresh C78/ARM evidence collector on current `dev` without approving or changing any tracked generated artifact.\\n\\n## Collector requirements\\n\\n`Capture-HomeDs402H37C78Evidence.ps1` fail-closes unless one evidence set contains:\\n\\n- explicit `BuildStartedUtc`\\n- fresh post-build `Class/Classes.lcb`, project `.lcb`, and `Network/Networks.lcb`\\n- C78 + ARM build-log evidence\\n- explicit zero compiler errors and successful linker evidence\\n- no `CInvalidArgException`\\n- direct-open PASS for HomeDS402 Start/Outcome/Retire/processor methods\\n- Network smoke PASS for TCPMotionInterface, LMCControlCommandService, LMCDiagnosticsService, and LMCEcatInputLatch\\n- generated artifact size/mtime/SHA-256 plus HEAD/working blob identities\\n- critical H37 source/verifier identities and working-tree state\\n\\n## Deliberate review boundary\\n\\nA successful real capture produces:\\n\\n- `GateResult: CAPTURED_FOR_REVIEW`\\n- `ArtifactRatchetDecision: REVIEW_REQUIRED`\\n- `SourceOnlyPhysicalIdentityGate: REVIEW_REQUIRED`\\n- `CapabilityActivation: KEEP_OFF`\\n\\nIt does **not** automatically update or approve the `Classes.lcb` physical-identity ratchet.\\n\\n## Qualification\\n\\nHead `cb50d49f10616ec378a3251bfad322a6adcac11c`, workflow run `33027409233`: **SUCCESS**\\n\\n- tracked generated artifact physical-identity report: PASS\\n- fresh C78 evidence collector self-test: PASS\\n- H37 production activation remains OFF verifier: PASS\\n- diff hygiene: PASS\\n\\nThis is collector/tooling qualification only. No real LASAL C78 rebuild evidence was captured by CI.\\n\\n## Safety boundary\\n\\n- no LASAL functional/runtime source change\\n- no generated artifact change\\n- no artifact hash ratchet change\\n- no PLC download/runtime claim\\n- no hardware/packet claim\\n- HomeDS402 bit 6 and five activation values remain OFF\\n\\nThis PR prepares H37-05/06 evidence collection; it does not complete H37-05 or old activation-only qualification branch is superseded.\\n\\n## 2026-08-28 current state\\n\\nThe branch ref has been realigned to exact current `dev@f3516e587e56e262532cbcf487665c1f102b8bdd`; it no longer carries an independent activation delta.\\n\\nCurrent `dev` itself is already qualification-active for the functions under issue #46:\\n\\n- `LMC_DIAG_SET_OPERATION_MODE_ENABLED TRUE`\\n- `LMC_DIAG_SET_OPERATION_MODE_SOFTWARE_MODES TRUE`\\n- Admin SetOperationMode triad in `0x00000717`\\n- supported mode mask `0x018A`\\n- Generic SDO global Write enabled\\n- PR #58 Operation Mode / Generic SDO live-bench corrections merged\\n\\nTherefore continuing to build this stale historical branch would only create source/image identity confusion. Physical qualification should use the exact current `dev` tree, with its source SHA, fresh LASAL C78/ARM artifact, loaded PLC image, and WPF source recorded as one evidence set.\\n\\nThis closure is administrative only; it does **not** claim PP/PV/IP hardware PASS or Generic SDO physical Write PASS. Production release remains NO-GO until the physical matrices and release activation review are complete.\\n\\nTracking: localization\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## Scope\\n\\nComplete Korean localization coverage for the dynamically created SetOperationMode / HomeDS402Ex recovery panels and close the CI coverage gap that allowed the recent localization code to change without running either WPF recovery workflow.\\n\\n## Fix\\n\\nAdd the two SetOperationMode labels that were still left in English when Korean UI is selected:\\n\\n- `Physical axis reference (1..4)` -> `물리 축 번호 (1..4)`\\n- `CyclicSynchronousPosition (8)` -> `CSP 위치 동기 모드 (8)`\\n\\n## Regression coverage\\n\\nAdd `RecentRecoveryPanelLocalizationTests` with a Korean -> English -> Korean round-trip against the actual dynamically created recovery panels. The test name contains both `SetOperationMode` and `HomeDS402Ex`, so each existing filtered WPF recovery workflow executes it.\\n\\nUpdate both WPF recovery workflow path filters so changes to:\\n\\n- `App.xaml.cs`\\n- `UiLocalization.cs`\\n- the new recent-recovery localization test\\n\\ntrigger the relevant qualification instead of silently receiving no PR run.\\n\\n## Boundary\\n\\n- WPF localization/test/CI-only change\\n- no SDK/protocol change\\n- no recovery lifecycle or no-replay behavior change\\n- no LASAL/PLC change\\n- no HomeDS402Ex runtime activation\\n- no hardware/profile values inferred\\n\\n## Current diff\\n\\nCompared with `dev@52bd4cc12081`:\\n\\n- 6 commits\\n- 6 files changed\\n- localization: 2 missing labels added\\n- regression: 1 focused round-trip smoke test added and registered\\n- CI: SetOperationMode + HomeDS402Ex WPF path coverage extended\\n\\n## Qualification\\n\\nPR-triggered SetOperationMode and HomeDS402Ex WPF recovery workflows are now Scope\\n\\nQualify the dynamic SetOperationMode/HomeDS402Ex recovery-panel localization that is already present on current `dev`.\\n\\n## Change\\n\\nStrengthen `RecentRecoveryPanelLocalizationTests` so the Korean -> English -> Korean round trip covers actual dynamically created content, not only group headers:\\n\\n- SetOperationMode axis/CSP labels\\n- SetOperationMode capability/recovery buttons\\n- HomeDS402Ex warning text\\n- HomeDS402Ex capability/recovery buttons\\n\\n## Why\\n\\nThe current `dev` localization fix was applied directly and therefore did not produce GitHub Actions runs. This PR changes only the focused regression test so both existing WPF recovery workflows are triggered against the exact current `dev` implementation.\\n\\n## Boundary\\n\\n- test-only change\\n- no SDK/protocol change\\n- no LASAL/PLC change\\n- no recovery lifecycle change\\n- no capability activation\\n- no HomeDS402Ex hardware/profile values inferred\\n\\n## Qualification\\n\\nHead `478fb2bd64279cd4f2f7c8a8c5d86624cc39fff3`:\\n\\n- SetOperationMode WPF recovery run `33026189333`: **SUCCESS**\\n  - Debug build/test PASS\\n  - Release build/test PASS\\n  - diff hygiene PASS\\n- HomeDS402Ex WPF recovery run `33026189342`: **SUCCESS**\\n  - Debug build/test PASS\\n  - Release build/test PASS\\n  - diff hygiene PASS\\n\\nThis closes the GitHub Actions evidence gap for the recovery\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## Scope\\n\\nImplement SetPosition SP-04A durable WPF no-replay recovery on current `dev` without enabling SetPosition production activation.\\n\\n## Implemented\\n\\n- dynamic SetPosition durable-recovery panel\\n- exact SetPosition recovery identity persisted before the one-shot `0x7D12` write boundary\\n- startup/reopen promotion `ArmedBeforeDispatch -> RecoveryRequired`\\n- unresolved-record endpoint/mutation interlock\\n- recovery sends only exact `0x7D14 ReadOutcome` and generation-bound `0x7D1A Retire`\\n- durable terminal proof before retirement\\n- original `0x7D12 Start` is never reconstructed or replayed by recovery\\n- successful SetPosition outcome-query result treated as terminal (`Succeeded` or `Rejected`)\\n- lifecycle-safe journal ownership: initialization is idempotent and the SetPosition recovery journal lock is released from the real WPF `Window.Closed` path\\n- focused smoke test proves a shown/loaded hidden MainWindow can close and immediately reopen the exact SetPosition journal lock\\n\\n## Final qualification head\\n\\n`573f3621e2e6d0f3495e37752d8aa72cd9e17b4c`\\n\\nGreen workflows on this head:\\n\\n- SetPosition WPF recovery `33032199842`: SUCCESS\\n  - Debug build/smoke PASS\\n  - Release build/smoke PASS\\n  - 14 SetPosition tests including startup promotion, dormant capability fail-closed, and Window.Close lock-release PASS\\n  - diff hygiene PASS\\n- SetOperationMode WPF recovery `33032199802`: SUCCESS\\n- HomeDS402Ex WPF recovery `33032199795`: SUCCESS\\n- HomeDS402 H37 source qualification `33032199777`: SUCCESS\\n  - activation/ownership/method-size/no-replay source checks PASS\\n  - API Debug/Release PASS\\n  - H37 WPF Debug/Release PASS\\n  - full SourceOnly reaches and classifies the existing exact generated-artifact boundary as designed\\n  - diff hygiene PASS\\n\\n## Activation boundary\\n\\nThis PR does **not** enable SetPosition. Production gates remain unchanged:\\n\\n- Store configured: OFF\\n- ordinary ownership: OFF\\n- per-axis max jump: 0\\n- Admin bits 3/5/7: OFF\\n- native SetPosition execution: not activated\\n\\nThe Start control remains fail-closed unless a future approved PLC advertises the full SetPosition/Outcome/Retire capability triad and all independent gates pass.\\n\\n## Deliberate exclusions / next tranche\\n\\n- no `_FileSys` A/B runtime backend yet\\n- no guessed vendor `CheckSum.CRC32`\\n- no hand-authored LASAL generated class/client ABI\\n- no RT native exactly-once implementation\\n- no C78/PLC/hardware SetPosition evidence\\n- no capability activation\\n\\nIssue #44 now tracks the vendor CRC golden fixture plus LASAL IDE-generated `_FileSys` ABI prerequisite. gate\",\"user\":{\"login\":\"dreiven61\",\"id\":148423840,\"node_id\":\"U_kgDOCNjEoA\",\"avatar_url\":\"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/148423840?v=4\",\"gravatar_id\":\"\",\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61\",\"html_url\":\"https://github.com/dreiven61\",\"followers_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/followers\",\"following_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/following{/other_user}\",\"gists_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/gists{/gist_id}\",\"starred_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/starred{/owner}{/repo}\",\"subscriptions_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/subscriptions\",\"organizations_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/orgs\",\"repos_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/repos\",\"events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/events{/privacy}\",\"received_events_url\":\"https://api.github.com/users/dreiven61/received_events\",\"type\":\"User\",\"user_view_type\":\"public\",\"site_admin\":false},\"body\":\"## Scope\\n\\nImplement the GitHub/host-side portion of SetPosition SP-01B factory provisioning without guessing vendor CRC behavior or hand-authoring LASAL generated `_FileSys` ABI.\\n\\n## Added\\n\\n- `tools/LmcSetPositionStoreDeploymentReceipt.ps1`\\n  - frozen manifest schema for controller/source/image identity\\n  - exact 2,048-byte A/B bundle checks\\n  - canonical UTF-8/LF JSONL receipt records\\n  - SHA-256 predecessor chaining\\n  - monotonic `FactoryNew -> FactoryInstallStarted -> VerifiedFactoryEmpty -> ActivationAuthorized -> Activated` state validation\\n  - append-only lock and fail-closed tamper detection\\n  - interrupted `FactoryInstallStarted` resume without duplicate append\\n- `tools/Start-LmcSetPositionStoreDeployment.ps1`\\n  - requires external inventory `FactoryNew` receipt\\n  - verifies bundle/serial/source identity and non-empty STOP/unload evidence\\n  - appends only `FactoryInstallStarted`\\n  - performs no PLC transfer or activation\\n- `tools/Verify-LmcSetPositionStoreDeployment.ps1`\\n  - verifies LASAL File Transfer readback A/B exact length/SHA/byte identity\\n  - requires exact two-record predecessor chain and same STOP evidence\\n  - appends only `VerifiedFactoryEmpty`\\n  - duplicate verification is rejected\\n- design/runbook for manual LASAL CLASS 2 `Debug -> File Transfer`\\n- Windows PowerShell 5.1 self-test workflow\\n\\n## Deliberate boundary\\n\\nThe synthetic CI images test only host manifest/receipt behavior. They are **not** valid SetPosition store-image evidence.\\n\\nStill blocked by issue #44:\\n\\n- vendor `CheckSum.CRC32` golden fixture\\n- host `Generate-LmcSetPositionStoreImages.ps1`\\n- LASAL IDE-generated `_FileSys` class/client ABI\\n- real runtime A/B header/body CRC, marker-last commit, reopen/readback, cold restart\\n\\nThis PR changes no LASAL runtime source and does not enable Store configured, ordinary ownership, Admin bits 3/5/7, max-jump, or native SetPosition
